## Checklist

- [ ] One focused change; no unrelated edits
- [ ] Every platform API / option called exists in the target DSH version (checked source, types, or the contract test)
- [ ] Added or updated tests for behaviour changes
- [ ] Did not edit generated `client.js` or `.release/`
- [ ] Updated docs when behaviour or defaults changed
- [ ] Conventional commit title (`type(scope): summary`)
